# Cinema-ye Do Zabaane (Bilingual Cinema)

> Short, simple movie reviews in two languages: first in English, then in Farsi. One film at a time. Hosted by Sohrab Amidi.

A solo podcast reviewing one film per episode, delivered first in English and then in Farsi, for English and Persian speakers alike.

## Listen

- [Show homepage](https://cdz-podcast.pages.dev/): episode list with players and downloads
- [RSS feed](https://cdz-podcast.pages.dev/feed.xml): the podcast feed read by Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and other apps

## About

- Host: Sohrab Amidi
- Languages: English and Persian (Farsi)
- Format: short single-film reviews, one film per episode
- Contact: sohrabssamedia@gmail.com
